name: Bare Dolls ~Shiro to Kuro no Sono~
source:
There is a convent with no name.
The establishment receives 2 girls named Izumi and Kyoko today.

From tomorrow, the training of the two starts...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ052512.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有一座修道院，没有名字。
今天，该酒店接待了两位名叫Izumi和Kyoko的女孩。

从明天开始，两人的训练就开始了……
